=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:130 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The cycle-exhausted path may post duplicate exhaustion comments because it checks a labels snapshot that can be stale.
  WHY: The label add is idempotent, but the comment is not.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:153-157 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `cycles_used` is computed across markers for all heads, so cycles consumed on an earlier head can exhaust or misnumber the budget for the current head.
  WHY: Deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro rated this NIT while minimax_minimax-m3 rated it MAJOR; using the higher severity, the stale cross-head count can leave a new head with too little cycle budget.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:188-199 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The audit is dispatched before its pending marker is posted, allowing a fast audit result to be superseded by the later pending marker.
  WHY: The next review can hold again until another review iteration or the stale-pending timeout.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:222-228 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: If no pending marker for the current head is found, report mode falls back to cycle 1 instead of preserving the dispatched cycle number.
  WHY: Deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro describes a missing or cleaned-up marker; minimax_minimax-m3 describes a failed pending-marker post. The resulting report comments can carry an inaccurate cycle number.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:159 | severity=low | confidence=[1]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: An unparseable pending-marker timestamp makes `age_hours` default to 0, treating the marker as fresh.
  WHY: A stale pending audit with a malformed timestamp would not be redispatched.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:50 | severity=low | confidence=[1]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The marker regex excludes `cycle=0`.
  WHY: If that value becomes valid in a future marker format, extraction will silently fail for it.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:5586-5606 | severity=low | confidence=[1]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The new step introduces a standalone-PR auto-merge hold capability.
  WHY: The review notes that eligibility is gated and the capability has a documented kill switch.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:78 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The marker trust filter accepts a broader set of authors than the function docstring's pipeline-account description implies.
  WHY: A trusted repo member could post a `status=clean` marker and bypass the gate before an audit ran.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:138 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The gate checks only the first linked issue for the verified-follow-up skip condition.
  WHY: With multiple linked issues, it can either apply the security pass to a follow-up PR or skip it for a real implementation PR.
- .github/workflows/security-audit.yml:294-296 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Findings extraction depends on a strict summary-line regex, and a format change would leave the findings count empty.
  WHY: A successful audit could then be reported as failed, consuming a cycle on a phantom failure.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:188-199 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Concurrent gate runs can read the same marker snapshot and dispatch duplicate audits because dispatch and pending-marker posting are not atomic.
  WHY: Two audits for the same PR head can produce duplicate result comments and follow-up sets.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:222-228 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The report-mode temporary comments file has no EXIT trap for cleanup.
  WHY: An interruption or early exit can leak a temporary file into `/tmp`.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:246 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Report mode redispatches the review workflow without checking whether the PR is still open.
  WHY: Closing the PR while the audit is in flight can still create a workflow run that immediately exits.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:131-137 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The smoke-test label check matches only the exact lowercase label name.
  WHY: A case or suffix variant can bypass the exclusion and cause a smoke-test PR to be held for an audit.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:128 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Uppercase head SHAs fail the lowercase-only SHA validation.
  WHY: A future wrapper that uppercases the SHA would silently disable the single-issue security pass for its PRs.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:188 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The dispatch assumes the consumer audit workflow declares the `pr_number` input.
  WHY: A customised or not-yet-updated consumer wrapper can reject the dispatch, causing the gate to proceed without the security pass.
- .github/workflows/security-audit.yml:296-323 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: If `GH_PAT` is unavailable, the fallback `GITHUB_TOKEN` may not reliably authorize the review redispatch as the audit job tears down.
  WHY: The audit result can be posted while the redispatch is lost, leaving the PR held without a review retry or clean marker.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:188 / 246 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Both workflow dispatch calls bypass `gh_retry`.
  WHY: A transient `gh` failure can log `dispatch_failed` and allow the PR to merge without the security pass.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:166-172 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: A `findings` marker for the current head always holds the gate before the cycle-exhaustion check, with no stale timeout.
  WHY: If follow-up issues close without changing the head, the PR can remain held indefinitely without exhaustion labeling or an escalation path.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: “A pending audit is treated as lost after 6 hours”; operators should be able to tune the stale-pending window via repo vars.
  expected_change_site: `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` env block at the new step (around line 5598) and/or the README/agents.md configuration tables.
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: No `SECURITY_PASS_PENDING_STALE_HOURS: ${{ vars.SECURITY_PASS_PENDING_STALE_HOURS || '6' }}` line in the step env block; no row for `SECURITY_PASS_PENDING_STALE_HOURS` in the README repository variables table (around lines 144-150) or in the agents.md variable table.
- requirement: `SINGLE_ISSUE_SECURITY_PASS_ENABLED` is documented as a repo variable with default `true`; disabling it should also prevent report mode from acting on in-flight audits.
  expected_change_site: `.github/workflows/security-audit.yml` env block for the `Report single-issue security pass` step (around lines 304-310), or a guard at the top of `single_pass_report`.
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: Neither env block nor script-level guard consults `SINGLE_ISSUE_SECURITY_PASS_ENABLED`; disabling the variable would still post result comments and re-dispatch reviews for an in-flight audit.
- requirement: The single-issue pass should be the standalone-PR equivalent of the orchestrator-level security pass, including a per-PR audit anchor for delta re-audits.
  expected_change_site: Either `scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh` (a per-PR "last audited SHA" comment marker, parallel to the orchestrator's `security_pass_last_audited_sha`), or `scripts/security_audit.sh` (a per-PR last-audited annotation that the single-issue pass writes before the audit).
  confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: No per-PR "last audited SHA" comment marker, no per-PR audit anchor in the comment stream, and no `SECURITY_AUDIT_DIFF_SINCE` propagation in the single-issue dispatch; it inherits only the global tracker last-audited SHA.
- requirement: “Findings become follow-up issues that target this PR branch; their merges start a new cycle”.
  expected_change_site: Either `scripts/security_audit.sh` to emit a per-PR findings count when an audit is dispatched for a single PR, or `security-audit.yml` to derive `SECURITY_PASS_FINDINGS` from the per-PR follow-up count rather than the tracker line.
  confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The single-issue pass's findings count is always the global tracker's surviving-findings count, not the per-PR follow-up set; if those counts diverge, the gate verdict does not match what the PR is being asked to fix.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:130 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: The `labels` variable is read from `pr_json` once at the top of `single_pass_gate()`, so the cycle-exhausted block may use stale labels and repeat its label and comment actions.
  WHY: The label is idempotent, but the comment is not, so duplicate exhausted comments can accumulate until a fresh metadata fetch.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:153-157 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: `cycles_used` is derived from the maximum cycle across all trusted markers, while `latest` is computed for the current head only.
  WHY: A failed marker for the current head can lead to a dispatched cycle number that does not follow that head's latest cycle; the report describes the number as cosmetic and potentially confusing to operators.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:188 (dispatch) and 199 (comment post) | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  PROBLEM: The audit dispatch occurs before the pending marker is posted.
  WHY: If the audit reports before the pending comment is posted, the pending marker can become latest and cause an extra review-cycle delay; the review says the timing window is very narrow.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:222-229 (single_pass_report) | severity=low | confidence=[1]
  PROBLEM: If no pending marker is found for the current head, report mode defaults the cycle number to 1.
  WHY: The review reports no functional impact because cycle numbering is cosmetic and budget accounting uses `cycles_used`.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:159 | severity=low | confidence=[1]
  PROBLEM: An empty or non-ISO `created_at` value causes the age calculation to fall back to 0.
  WHY: A malformed timestamp would keep a stale pending marker fresh; the review notes that the GitHub API reliably emits ISO-8601 timestamps.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:50 | severity=low | confidence=[1]
  PROBLEM: The marker regex requires a cycle number starting with 1-9 and does not match `cycle=0`.
  WHY: The review describes this as a forward-compatibility concern if `cycle=0` becomes valid.
